import {
    DEFAULT_ACTIONS_FOLDER,
    DEFAULT_ARCHIVED_FOLDER,
    DEFAULT_CARD_TYPES,
    DEFAULT_DIAGRAM_FOOTER,
    DEFAULT_DIAGRAMS_FOLDER,
    DEFAULT_DIFF_COMMAND,
    DEFAULT_PROJECT_FOLDER,
    DEFAULT_RELEASES_FOLDER,
    DEFAULT_STATES,
    DEFAULT_WORKING_FOLDER,
    type CardTypeConfig,
    type PinnedConversationLocator,
    type PushMode,
    type StateConfig,
} from '../../data/data_types'
import {
    BUILTIN_AGENT_PROFILES,
    type AgentProfile,
} from '../../data/agent_profiles'
import { DEFAULT_AGENT_SELECTION, type AgentSelectionState } from '../../data/agent_selection'
import type { ProjectBackgroundShade } from '../../theme/project_background_shade'
import { DEFAULT_CARD_SEPARATOR, type CardSeparator } from '../../data/card_identifiers'

export type ConfigSource = 'react' | 'desktop' | 'project'
export type ConfigValueType = 'boolean' | 'number' | 'select' | 'string' | 'json'

export interface ConfigValueTypes {
    'desktop.agentSelection': AgentSelectionState
    'desktop.agentProfiles': AgentProfile[]
    'desktop.codexSearchEnabled': boolean
    'desktop.editorCommand': string
    'desktop.mergeConflictResolverCommand': string
    'desktop.remoteControlPort': number
    'project.actionsFolder': string
    'project.archivedFolder': string
    'project.backgroundShade': ProjectBackgroundShade
    'project.cardSeparator': CardSeparator
    'project.cardTypes': CardTypeConfig[]
    'project.diffCommand': string
    'project.diagramFooter': string
    'project.diagramsFolder': string
    'project.pinnedConversations': PinnedConversationLocator[]
    'project.projectFolder': string
    'project.pushMode': PushMode
    'project.releasesFolder': string
    'project.states': StateConfig[]
    'project.workingFolder': string
    'react.autoCommitDelayMs': number
    'react.deleteBranchAfterIntegration': boolean
    'react.deleteBranchesAfterRelease': boolean
    'react.includeProjectActivityInRelease': boolean
    'react.showStartupSplash': boolean
}

export type ConfigKey = keyof ConfigValueTypes

export type ConfigValue = boolean
    | number
    | string
    | string[]
    | AgentProfile[]
    | AgentSelectionState
    | CardTypeConfig[]
    | PinnedConversationLocator[]
    | StateConfig[]

export interface ConfigOption {
    label: string
    value: string
}

export interface ConfigEntry {
    defaultValue: ConfigValue
    description: string
    editable: boolean
    input?: 'multiline' | 'slider'
    integer?: boolean
    key: ConfigKey
    label: string
    max?: number
    min?: number
    options?: ConfigOption[]
    section: string
    source: ConfigSource
    step?: number
    type: ConfigValueType
}

export type ConfigValues = ConfigValueTypes

export interface DesktopConfigValues {
    agentSelection: AgentSelectionState
    agentProfiles: AgentProfile[]
    codexSearchEnabled?: boolean
    editorCommand: string
    mergeConflictResolverCommand: string
    remoteControlPort: number
}

export const CONFIG_SECTIONS = [
    { id: 'react', label: 'React app' },
    { id: 'project', label: 'Project' },
    { id: 'desktop', label: 'Desktop' },
]

const DEFAULT_AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS = 30000
const MIN_AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS = 1000
const MAX_AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS = 120000
export const DEFAULT_EDITOR_COMMAND = 'code -g "{{file}}:{{line}}"'

    },

const CONFIG_ENTRY_BY_KEY = new Map(CONFIG_ENTRIES.map((entry) => [entry.key, entry]))

export const PROJECT_KEYS: ConfigKey[] = [
    'project.projectFolder',
    'project.workingFolder',
    'project.actionsFolder',
    'project.releasesFolder',
    'project.diagramsFolder',
    'project.archivedFolder',
    'project.backgroundShade',
    'project.diffCommand',
    'project.diagramFooter',
    'project.pushMode',
    'project.cardSeparator',
    'project.cardTypes',
    'project.states',
    'project.pinnedConversations',
]

export const DESKTOP_KEYS: ConfigKey[] = CONFIG_ENTRIES.filter(
    (entry) => entry.source === 'desktop',
).map((entry) => entry.key)

export const LOCAL_STORAGE_KEYS: ConfigKey[] = CONFIG_ENTRIES.filter(
    (entry) => entry.source === 'react',
).map((entry) => entry.key)

export function createDefaultValues(): ConfigValues {
    return CONFIG_ENTRIES.reduce((values, entry) => ({ ...values, [entry.key]: entry.defaultValue }), {} as ConfigValues)
}

export function requireConfigEntry(key: ConfigKey) {
    const entry = CONFIG_ENTRY_BY_KEY.get(key)
    if (!entry) throw new Error(`Unknown config key: ${key}`)

    return entry
}

---

id: F_370
internalId: 1e7b5718-e065-479d-9d50-be0ff38d738f
title: config dialog project tab improvements
status: ready

---
we need to improve the layout of the project tab on the config dialog:

* the first section is a list of input from project-folder to archive folder. these should be grouped together, title 'folders' with a short explanation with this is about.
* diagram footer should be moved down to the end
* all git related configs should be grouped, title 'git' with explanation (so diff command, push mode)
* card related configs should be grouped: card separator, card types, columns
* for card types, instead of editing a row array, lets create a custom component, that allows the user to add, delete the types, show the color as background of the button that represents the type. when clicked, user can edit details. use color picker to set the color, inputs for the others.
* similar for columns: create a custom component with buttons

## Current state

`ProjectConfigSection` in `app/src/components/config/project_config_section.tsx` filters `entries` down to `entry.section === 'project'` and hands the whole list to `ConfigSectionLayout`, which renders one `Typography variant="h6"` heading ("Project") and then a flat `Stack spacing={3}` of `ConfigValueEditor` elements, one per entry, in `CONFIG_ENTRIES` declaration order. There is no grouping construct and no per-group explanation anywhere in the config page today. `WorktreeConfigList` is appended after the flat stack when `worktreeService.isSupported()` and the section is not disabled.

The declaration order in `app/src/services/config/config_entries.ts` is therefore the on-screen order: Project folder, Working folder, Actions folder, Releases folder, Diagrams folder, Archived folder, Background shade, Diff command, Diagram footer, Push mode, Card separator, Card types, Columns. `project.pinnedConversations` is also in the project section but carries `editable: false`; it is not part of this feature. So the diagram footer, a six-row multiline text field, currently sits in the middle of the tab between the diff command and the push mode, which is what makes the tab hard to scan.

`project.cardTypes` and `project.states` both have `type: 'json'`, so `ConfigValueEditor` renders each one as a monospace multiline `TextField` (their keys are in `MONOSPACE_CONFIG_KEYS`) that holds the raw JSON array text in local `jsonText` state, calls `JSON.parse` on blur, and passes the parsed value to `onChange`. A `JSON.parse` failure on blur throws out of the handler; there is no inline validation. `configService.validateValue` then runs `validateCardTypes` or `validateStates` on the parsed value when the draft is committed.

A card type is `{ color, idPrefix, label, type }`, where `type` is the free-form string stored on each card. A column is `{ alwaysVisible, color?, defaultActionId?, state }`; `validateStates` fills a missing colour with `defaultColumnAccent(index)` and rejects duplicate `state` values. Array order is the board column order.

Two precedents already exist for replacing a JSON blob with a real editor. `AgentProfilesEditor` in `app/src/components/config/agent_profiles_editor.tsx` is wired in through an `entry.key === 'desktop.agentProfiles'` branch in `ConfigValueEditor`: it renders a list of rows plus an inline add/edit form, computes its own error list, and reports it upward through `onValidityChange`, which `ConfigPage` collects into `invalidConfigKeys` to gate the Save button. `ThemeSettingsDialog` in `app/src/components/shell/theme_settings_dialog.tsx` already picks colours with a plain MUI `TextField type="color"`; no colour-picker package is installed and none is needed.

Existing tests that touch this area: `config_page.test.tsx` asserts the background shade options, the card separator warning and rename flow, and edits 
[7392 characters omitted]
` and `columns_editor.grouped.test.tsx` next to the existing `*.grouped.test.tsx` files, covering add, edit, colour change, delete, that Cancel discards an edit, and the uniqueness and non-empty validation paths with the resulting disabled `Save`. For columns, also cover that `Move left` / `Move right` reorder the array, that `Always visible` and `Default action` round-trip through the popup, and that selecting `None` omits `defaultActionId` from the saved column. Test the drag reorder at the `onDragEnd` level: extract the reorder into a pure exported helper (`reorderColumns(states, activeId, overId)`) in `columns_editor.tsx` and assert on that directly, since jsdom cannot produce the pointer events `@dnd-kit` needs — `card_sequence_dialog.test.tsx` sidesteps the same limitation by wrapping the tree in a bare `DndContext` and never dragging. Replace the `edits project columns as ordered JSON definitions` case in `config_page.test.tsx` with one that drives the new column editor, and add a case asserting the Folders, Cards, Git, Appearance and Diagrams group headings appear in that order in the project tab. Verify with `npm run typecheck` and the config vitest suites.

## acceptance criteria

* The project tab shows five headed groups in this order — Folders, Cards, Git, Appearance, Diagrams — each with a one-line explanation under its heading, followed by the worktree list where it is supported.
* Folders holds project, working, actions, releases, diagrams and archived folder; Cards holds card separator, card types and columns; Git holds diff command and push mode; Appearance holds background shade; Diagrams holds the diagram footer, which is the last config field on the tab.
* An editable project config entry that is not assigned to a group still renders on the tab rather than disappearing.
* Card types render as a row of buttons, one per type, each filled with that type's colour, labelled with that type's label, and with text contrast readable against both light and dark accents.
* Clicking a card type button opens a popup with Label, Type, ID prefix and a colour input; saving applies the change to the draft, and Cancel or Escape leaves the draft untouched.
* `Add card type` appends a new type; `Delete` removes one; deleting the last remaining card type is blocked.
* Editing a card type's Type field is allowed and shows a warning that existing cards keep the old value and lose their colour and ID prefix.
* Duplicate Type or ID prefix values, or an empty Label, Type or ID prefix, show an inline error and disable Save, and the config dialog's Save button stays disabled while that entry is invalid.
* Columns render the same way, in board order; clicking one opens a popup with Name, colour, Always visible, Default action, Move left, Move right, Save, Cancel and Delete.
* Dragging a column button onto another column moves it to that position and persists the new order to the draft; a short click still opens the popup instead of starting a drag, and a drop outside the row leaves the order unchanged.
* `Move left` and `Move right` change the column's position in the stored array and are disabled at the first and last position respectively, so reordering is possible without a pointer.
* `Always visible` and `Default action` are editable from the popup; `Default action` lists the project's loaded actions plus `None`, and choosing `None` saves the column with no `defaultActionId` key at all.
* Editing, moving or adding a column preserves the field values of every other column.
* Duplicate or empty column names show an inline error and disable Save; deleting the last remaining column is blocked.
* Saving a draft that removed a card type or a column raises one warning dialog naming what was removed, and then saves normally when confirmed.
* Neither card types nor columns renders as a JSON textarea any more, and the stored project config format for both is byte-compatible with what the previous JSON editor produced.
* `npm run typecheck` passes and the config page, card types editor and columns editor test suites pass.

## Current state

The config dialog's tab list comes from `CONFIG_SECTIONS` in `app/src/services/config/config_entries.ts`, today `react` ("React app"), `project` and `desktop`. `getVisibleSections` in `app/src/components/config/config_page.tsx` walks that list and appends the Markdown tab right after the `react` section and the Sentry tab right after the `project` section, so the Markdown tab exists today only because a `react` section exists. `getActiveSection` falls back to the first visible section when the hash names no known section, so the React app tab is also the default tab.

Every config entry carries two independent fields: `section`, which decides the tab it renders on, and `source` (`react` | `desktop` | `project`), which decides where the value is stored. Five entries currently use `section: 'react'` and `source: 'react'`:

* `react.showStartupSplash` (default `true`, editable) — read by `app/src/app.tsx` through `readStartupSplashPreference()` in `app/src/services/config/config_persistence.ts`. That helper reads localStorage directly because `App` needs the value before `configService.init` runs; `app.tsx` renders `<StartupSplash />` only while `bootstrap.phase === 'starting'` and the preference is on.
* `react.deleteBranchAfterIntegration` (default `false`, `editable: false`) — seeds the "delete branch" checkbox of the worktree integration dialog in `app/src/components/worktree_selector.tsx:58`, and is written back on every toggle at `worktree_selector.tsx:286`.
* `react.deleteBranchesAfterRelease` (default `false`, `editable: false`) — seeds `defaultSelectAll` for the branch list of `CompleteReleaseDialog`, read at `app/src/components/shell/project/use_project_toolbar_menu_actions.ts:89` and written back at line 391.
* `react.includeProjectActivityInRelease` (default `false`, `editable: false`) — seeds the "Include project agent activity" checkbox of `CompleteReleaseDialog`, read at `use_project_toolbar_menu_actions.ts:90` and written back at line 395. The checkbox value travels as the third argument of `onCompleteRelease` into `projectSessionService.completeRelease` and then `releaseOperations.completeRelease` (`app/src/services/release_operations.ts:162`), where it decides whether `loadArchivedProjectActivity` runs and the project agent activity is copied into the release folder.
* `react.autoCommitDelayMs` (default 30000, editable slider, 1000–120000 step 1000) — read once in the `DataService` constructor (`app/src/services/data/data_service.ts:223`) and passed to `new CommitBatcher(this.cards, delayMs)`. `CommitBatcher.delayMs` (`app/src/data/commit_batcher.ts:112`) is `readonly` and only consulted in `window.setTimeout(..., this.delayMs)` at line 162, so today the delay is frozen at app start.

`editable: false` does not hide an entry from the React app tab: `ReactConfigSection` passes every `section === 'react'` entry to `ConfigSectionLayout`, which renders them all. The flag is only consulted by `ProjectConfigSection` when deciding which ungrouped project entries to render. So the three branch/release booleans are visible in the React app tab today, and are simultaneously the remembered state of dialog checkboxes.

Spec + code surveyed. Plan below. No edits yet.

## Change Plan — F_371

**Block 1 — config entry + storage model**
`services/config/config_entries.ts`: drop `ConfigSource` member `'react'`, the 5 `react.*` keys in `ConfigValueTypes`, their 5 `CONFIG_ENTRIES` items, the `{ id: 'react', label: 'React app' }` section, and `LOCAL_STORAGE_KEYS`. Add `project.deleteBranchAfterIntegration`, `project.deleteBranchesAfterRelease`, `project.autoCommitDelayMs` (same labels/descriptions/defaults/slider bounds, `section: 'project'`, `source: 'project'`, `editable: true`) and append them to `PROJECT_KEYS`.
`data/data_types.ts`: add the three fields to `ProjectConfig`.
`services/config/config_persistence.ts`: delete `REACT_CONFIG_STORAGE_KEY`, `readStoredReactValues`, `writeStoredReactValues`, `mergeStoredReactValues`, `readStartupSplashPreference`.
`services/config/config_service.ts`: drop those imports/re-exports, `ReactConfigKey`, `setReactPreference`, the `mergeStoredReactValues` call in `init` and the `writeStoredReactValues` call in `saveDraft`; map the three fields in `readProjectConfig`; add three `if (projectConfig?.x !== undefined)` merge lines in `loadProjectConfig`; add `setProjectPreference` modeled on `setConversationPinned` (validate → persist via `withProjectConfigSave` → commit to `values`, mirror into an open draft, dispatch `changed`; silent no-op when no project loaded).

**Block 2 — splash always on**
`app.tsx`: delete the `readStartupSplashPreference` import and `showStartupSplash`; render `<StartupSplash />` unconditionally while `bootstrap.phase === 'starting'`.

**Block 3 — dialog tabs and Git group**
Delete `components/config/react_config_section.tsx`. `config_page.tsx`: drop its import and the `activeSection === 'react'` branch; in `getVisibleSections` hang `MARKDOWN_CONFIG_SECTION` off the `project` section after Sentry → order Project, Sentry, Markdown, Desktop, and `getActiveSection`'s `sections[0]` fallback lands on Project (so `#/config/react` shows Project).
`project_config_section.tsx`: Git group keys become diff command, push mode, delete-integrated-branch, delete-released-branches, auto-commit delay; widen the group description to cover branch cleanup and the auto-commit delay.

**Block 4 — dialog write-backs onto project config**
`worktree_selector.tsx:58,286` and `use_project_toolbar_menu_actions.ts:89,391` switch to the new project keys and `configService.setProjectPreference`. Remove `releaseIncludeProjectActivityDefault` / `setReleaseIncludeProjectActivityDefault` and the third `completeRelease` argument.

**Block 5 — release always archives project activity**
`release_operations.ts:162` and `project_session_service.ts:565`: drop the `includeProjectActivity` parameter; `loadArchivedProjectActivity` always runs. `complete_release_dialog.tsx`: remove the `defaultIncludeProjectActivity` / `onIncludeProjectActivityChange` props, the state, handler, checkbox, and the third `onCompleteRelease` argument. Unwire in `app_menu.tsx:670` and `project_toolbar_menu.tsx:135`.

**Block 6 — per-project auto-commit delay**
`commit_batcher.ts`: replace the `delayMs` constructor argument with `delayMsProvider: () => number` (default `() => AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS`), called at the `window.setTimeout` in `scheduleFlush`, so each newly scheduled flush reads the loaded project's value; an already-scheduled timeout keeps its delay. `data_service.ts:223`: pass `() => configService.get('project.autoCommitDelayMs')`.

**Block 7 — tests**
`App.test.tsx`: drop the disabled-preference case, keep default-on. `config_page.test.tsx`: replace React-tab cases — tab list is Project/Sentry/Markdown/Desktop, no "React app" tab, no "Startup splash" switch, Git group holds the five fields in order; re-home the save/cancel/Escape/slider cases onto project-tab fields. `main_window.test.tsx:303-311`: use a project field instead of the splash switch. `config_persistence.service.test.ts` / `config_service.service.test.ts`: drop react-blob and `hasDraftChangesForSource('react')` cases, move onto project keys, add a `setProjectPreference` case (persists through the project-config boundary, updates an open draft). `worktree_selector.test.tsx:571-585`: project key + `setProjectPreference`. `project_dialogs.test.tsx`: include-activity checkbox gone. `release_operations.service.test.ts`: drop the opt-out case, assert a release always archives project activity. Plus key renames in `config_value_editor.grouped.test.tsx`, `data_service.service.test.ts`, `project_loading.test.ts`, and `commit_batcher.test.ts` provider signature.

**Block 8 — verify**
`npm run typecheck`, then only the config, release, worktree, app, commit-batcher and project-dialog suites. Then set `status: ready` in `design/feature_descriptions/F_371_remove_react_app_tab_from_config_dialog.md`.

Note: no TodoWrite/task tool exists in this session, so the blocks above are the task list — I'll work them in order.

Approve?

entries.content:
F_371 done. All blocks implemented, typecheck clean, targeted suites green (496 tests, 32 files).

**What changed**

- **Config model** (`config_entries.ts`): `ConfigSource` drops `'react'`; the five `react.*` keys and entries are gone; three keys re-homed as `project.deleteBranchAfterIntegration`, `project.deleteBranchesAfterRelease`, `project.autoCommitDelayMs` (`section`/`source: 'project'`, `editable: true`, same labels/defaults/slider bounds) and appended to `PROJECT_KEYS`. `LOCAL_STORAGE_KEYS` and the `react` tab entry removed.
- **Storage**: `ProjectConfig` gains the three fields (plus `DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG`); `readProjectConfig` maps them; `loadProjectConfig` merges them only when the file defines them, so an older project config file falls back to the entry defaults. `config_persistence.ts` is now just the desktop bridge — the `md2.reactConfig` blob helpers and `readStartupSplashPreference` are deleted, and nothing reads or writes that key any more. `ConfigService.setReactPreference` is replaced by `setProjectPreference`, which validates, persists through `withProjectConfigSave` → `saveProjectConfig(readProjectConfig(...))`, then commits to `values`, mirrors into an open draft, and dispatches `changed`; it returns without throwing while no project is open.
- **Splash**: `app.tsx` renders `<StartupSplash />` unconditionally while `bootstrap.phase === 'starting'`.
- **Dialog**: `react_config_section.tsx` deleted; the Markdown tab now hangs off the `project` section after Sentry, so tabs are Project, Sentry, Markdown, Desktop and the `getActiveSection` fallback makes Project the default — `#/config/react` lands on Project. The Git group holds diff command, push mode, both branch settings, auto commit delay, with a description covering branch cleanup and the auto-commit wait.
- **Release**: `includeProjectActivity` removed from `releaseOperations.completeRelease`, `projectSessionService.completeRelease`, `onCompleteRelease`, and the `CompleteReleaseDialog` props/state/checkbox (and its two call sites), so `loadArchivedProjectActivity` always runs.
- **Auto-commit delay**: `CommitBatcher` takes `delayMsProvider: () => number` (default `() => AUTO_COMMIT_DELAY_MS`), called where the timeout is scheduled; `data_service.ts` passes `() => configService.get('project.autoCommitDelayMs')`. An already-scheduled flush keeps its old delay; the next one picks up the loaded project's value.

**Two things beyond the literal spec, both forced by the async write**

1. The worktree integration dialog's "Delete branch" checkbox was purely config-driven. With the write now async (it awaits the project config save), clicking the box and immediately clicking Integrate would have used the stale value, so `WorktreeSelector` keeps a local `deleteBranch` state seeded from the preference when the dialog opens; it still writes the preference back.
2. Three `project_loading` and two `data_service` tests set the delay *before* `openProject`, which `loadProjectConfig` then resets to the default — the value is per project now, so those `configService.set` calls moved to just after the project opens.

**One pre-existing failure, unrelated**: `src/services/data/card_operations.test.ts > rejects an existing archived-card target before committing` fails identically with my changes stashed. Left as is.

Note: the app's own auto-commit (`2df810c6 Save project changes before worktree synchronization`) swept most of these edits into a commit while I worked; the remaining edits are uncommitted in the working tree.
Commit all

Remove the React app tab from the config dialog

The React app tab held a startup-splash switch, two branch-cleanup
booleans, an include-project-activity-in-release boolean and the
auto-commit delay, all stored in one localStorage blob shared by every
project. The tab is gone and the react config source with it:

- The startup splash is always shown while the last project is restored;
  no entry and no reader remain.
- Delete integrated card branch, delete released card branches and auto
  commit delay are project config now, stored per project in the project
  config file and edited in the project tab's Git group. A config file
  written before this change defines none of them and falls back to the
  entry defaults.
- Release always archives the project agent activity, so the
  complete-release dialog no longer asks.

ConfigService.setProjectPreference replaces setReactPreference for the
two dialog write-backs; it persists through the project config boundary
and updates an open draft. Because that write is async, the worktree
integration dialog keeps the pending delete-branch choice in local state
seeded from the preference, so integrating right after ticking the box
uses the ticked value.

CommitBatcher takes a delay provider instead of a fixed delay, read when
each flush is scheduled, so the delay follows the loaded project without
an app restart.

The Markdown tab now hangs off the project section, making the tab order
Project, Sentry, Markdown, Desktop and Project the default tab; an old
#/config/react link lands there too.

Also includes an unrelated action_run_registry fix that applies the
event status for every agent update kind.
